name: Xaphan
source:
Age: XX | LV 9 Reaper

Xaphan is the life of the party. He knows that the other guys can be sticks in the muds, and he considers it his duty to bring some joy to the place.

His eyepatch holds some painful secrets, and he'll do anything to avoid talking about them.

He'd describe himself as "the reliable one." A highly contested fact, by some.

LIKES
Playing MMOs, manga, bread, going to arcades, playing hookey from work, watching cat videos

DISLIKES
Scary movies, when Orias is being annoying, spicy food, work, cleaning, tech support hotlines
